name: AI Singapore
description: National programmes spanning research, products, innovation and talent.

name: NUS AI Institute
description: An institute bringing together foundational and applied AI research with work on societal impact for public good.

name: National AI Impact Programme
description: A national programme supporting enterprises and workers as they build practical AI capability and adoption.

name: AI Verify Foundation
description: An open-source community building AI governance testing tools, standards and practical assurance resources.

name: A*STAR
founder: Agency for Science, Technology and Research
description: Singapore’s public research agency, connecting scientific discovery, engineering and translation across the innovation ecosystem.

name: NTU AI Research Institute
description: A university-wide institute coordinating AI research and applying it across engineering, health, urban systems and society.

name: NTU Centre of AI-for-X
description: An interdisciplinary research hub developing AI methods and applying them across engineering, finance, medicine, sustainability and social science.

name: SUTD Artificial Intelligence
founder: Singapore University of Technology and Design
description: A multidisciplinary programme connecting AI education, research and industry implementation with a design-led approach.

name: SGInnovate
description: Invests in deep-tech startups, develops talent and builds connections across Singapore’s emerging technology community.

name: Sea AI Lab
description: A Singapore-based research lab working on core AI research and AI-empowered research in challenging fields.

name: PatSnap
description: An AI-native platform helping R&D and IP teams find, interpret and act on scientific and patent intelligence.

name: TAIGER
description: Develops AI solutions that automate knowledge work through natural language processing, machine learning and reasoning.

name: Biofourmis
description: Builds AI-powered health analytics and digital therapeutics that support more personalised care and clinical decisions.

name: Institute of Advanced Intelligence and Computing
description: A*STAR research entity working on advanced intelligence and computing capabilities in Singapore.

name: National Supercomputing Centre Singapore
description: National high-performance computing infrastructure supporting research, innovation and AI work across Singapore.

name: Digital Trust Centre
description: National trust-technology research centre that leads work including AI safety, testing and digital trust innovation.

name: Singapore AI Safety Institute
founder: Housed at the Digital Trust Centre
description: Singapore’s AI safety research capability, bringing together research work on evaluation, testing and AI safety science.

name: A*STAR Institute for Infocomm Research
founder: Agency for Science, Technology and Research
description: A*STAR research institute with work spanning AI, language and speech, data analytics, cybersecurity, robotics and health technologies.

name: Centre of AI in Medicine
founder: NTU Singapore and National Healthcare Group
description: Applied research centre advancing AI in healthcare across mental health, frailty, medical imaging and cancer screening.

name: National AI Research and Development Plan
founder: Ministry of Digital Development and Information
description: National plan supporting fundamental and applied AI research, research centres of excellence and talent development through 2030.

name: OpenAI Singapore Applied AI Lab
description: Singapore Applied AI Lab announced to support applied AI innovation, deployment talent and work across public services, finance, healthcare and digital infrastructure.

name: NVIDIA Singapore AI Research Lab
description: Singapore research lab announced to work with university researchers, industry and government on embodied and efficient AI for manufacturing.

name: AI Agents Sandbox
description: A public-private sandbox studying how computer-use AI agents behave in practice, including risk and governance implications.

name: Project Moonshot
founder: IMDA and AI Verify Foundation collaborators
description: A testing and evaluation initiative linked to AI Verify, advancing methods and benchmarks for large language model assurance.

name: Datature
description: A computer vision platform for managing data, training models and deploying vision AI across sectors such as manufacturing, agriculture and healthcare.

name: GovTech Singapore
description: Singapore’s government technology agency, contributing to practical work on public-sector digital systems and AI deployment.

name: Cyber Security Agency of Singapore
description: National cyber security agency participating in public work on how computer-use AI agents behave, are tested and are governed in practice.

name: National Research Foundation Singapore
description: National agency supporting Singapore’s research and innovation system, including AI research capability under the National AI Research and Development Plan.

name: AI Verify
description: A testing framework and toolkit for validating AI-system performance against internationally recognised principles through standardised tests.

name: AI4SME
description: A public platform connecting small and medium enterprises to validated AI solution providers.

name: AimSG
description: An app store for medical-imaging professionals to access AI tools in a health-care setting.

name: A*STAR T-UP Programme
founder: Agency for Science, Technology and Research
description: A programme placing A*STAR scientists and engineers with SMEs to develop technology capability and innovation.

name: TechSkills Accelerator
description: A SkillsFuture initiative developing Singapore’s ICT workforce, including AI and analytics capability.

name: Pinnacle AI Industry Programme
description: A TeSA programme for frontier companies building or fine-tuning enterprise large language models and developing local AI talent.

name: AI for Fun — Primary
description: A school enrichment programme introducing upper-primary students to AI and computational thinking.

name: AI for Fun — Secondary
description: A school module offering secondary students practical learning on data, bias, large language models and custom chatbots.

name: 100 Experiments
description: An implementation framework that pairs AI Singapore engineering capability with organisations developing proof-of-concepts and production AI projects.

name: AI Apprenticeship Programme
description: A full-time apprenticeship that combines deep-skilling with project work on real-world AI initiatives.

name: AI Readiness Index
description: An industry-facing assessment framework helping companies identify appropriate AI capability and adoption pathways.

name: AI Advisory
description: Discovery workshops and AI-ready clinics that help organisations identify and prioritise practical AI use cases.

name: AI for Industry
description: An industry learning programme supporting organisations assessing and building their AI capability.

name: SEA-LION
description: AI Singapore’s open language model effort for Southeast Asian languages and contexts.

name: National Speech Corpus
description: A national speech-data initiative supporting the development of locally relevant speech and language technologies.

name: Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI
description: A public governance framework for practical, responsible deployment of agentic AI systems.

name: National AI Council
description: A national council providing strategic direction for Singapore’s AI agenda under the refreshed National AI Strategy.
